mission.title: Fabrication
mission.description: Investigate an outbreak of overrides, find Halborn and Carlyne, and attend Halborn's meeting with the Architect.

npc.say:
No? Ah... Hm...
Well! That's too bad. No, no; don't let me keep you. "Appointed rounds," and all that, eh? That's wonderful. Carry on, then.

Have you... Uh... I don't really know how to say this...
Have you seen a guy who looks like a 3D computer graphic?
No--no, seriously.

The palm reader? Yes, I've heard her mentioned... Hm...
Come to think of it, those Zionites kept saying her name, and then cutting each other off. I didn't think they knew what they were jabbering about.
No... They couldn't know...

phase.briefing:
{player}, an outbreak of programmatic overrides has been detected. You are assigned to investigate.
At this time it is unknown if this was caused by Carlyne or Halborn; both of them are capable of having executed it.

enter.say:
Man, I bet they're working together. They're gonna come at us in a big override pinscher--
Huh, redpills--unregistered ones, too--plus overridden programs. You've got your hands full on this one.

done.say:
Huh. Now all we need is for some Mervs to show up and try to steal the bodies.
Hey, I'm getting a call from Gray. You'd better hit the street.

phase.briefing:
Continued scans of that area have registered a code signature matching the profile of either Halborn or Carlyne. You are to proceed to that area immediately and investigate.
They have each met separately with Zion, and the Merovingian. Halborn continues to search for the program he believes exists inside the simulation, while Carlyne seems to be attempting to gain a support base with all organizations. This activity in particular could produce...complications. Additionally, Carlyne divulged to our operatives that Halborn seeks the "biological interface program" because Halborn's human body is dead.
As we believe that both of them are still taking a non-hostile stance relative to our organization, you are not authorized to use force against either one, should you encounter them. Evaluate the situation, and report.

enter.say:
So they're both trying to work the system, huh?
Well, one of them is definitely in there. I've got some override program activity, too, and something... Huh, well, it isn't an Agent...

talk.say:
Huh. What kept you?
I want to talk to your boss' boss. Go make it happen.

done.say: *Man* that guy is infuriating. One of these days...

near.say:
Oh goody, the unpleasant one.
Oh, a "red eye" Agent. So that's what was on the scan. Wonder where he dug it up.

phase.briefing:
...
Thank you, operative. I will see to this.
Override use apart from Halborn is still being detected in that area. He may have left other pockets of override programs. Please investigate the indicated location.

enter.say:
I've got just one big override in there... Did we just go in a circle and smack into Halborn again? Or...
Hey, and I'm picking up a civilian in there, too.

talk.say:
Oh...hell-o there, {player}! What a pleasant surprise!
Why, I'm tracking Halborn, of course. He's around here somewhere. You haven't seen him, by any chance?
Tell him that you have not seen Halborn, operative, and leave as soon as you can excuse yourself without drawing suspicion.

near.say: Well, isn't it just our lucky day.

He... He shook my hand.
That was...really weird.

phase.briefing: The meeting with Halborn is arranged, operative. Please come to my location.

enter.say:
Looks like you're hanging with the bigwigs. They're all up there. Security's tighter than--
Never mind.

talk.say:
Halborn's request for a consultation with us at this time is likely due to concern over his pursuit by Carlyne. If he feels that he requires our help, this raises the possibility to establish control over him.
You understand this, {player}? Very well; proceed into the adjoining chamber.
So, you didn't make it. Fine. I want to know who did. Don't make this more difficult than it has to be.

... I have every intention of expediting your departure from this simulation by every means at my disposal.
The program's author is known as the Oracle.

mission.finish:
This changes the situation significantly, operative. Zion and E Pluribus Neo have typically taken it upon themselves to protect the Oracle from perceived threats against her. If Halborn attempts to find her, they may intervene; also, we cannot ignore the fact that the Oracle has considerable efficiency in manipulating those around her.
Halborn may intend to force her to divulge information concerning the function of the program he seeks. In any case, his obsession has now brought her to the forefront of this affair.
You are dismissed to your regular duties for the time being. Expect further orders to be forthcoming within the usual period.
